Hi, I'm Jay Himanshu Jivandas.

I'm a senior Computer Science and Engineering student at The Ohio State University with a minor in Business, originally from Dubai, UAE. I'm passionate about building things, solving real problems, and figuring out how technology can make life easier.

Most of my time goes into projects, research, and exploring ideas at the intersection of AI, software, and entrepreneurship. When I'm not at my laptop, I'm usually pursuing one or more of my hobbies.

I built this site for people who want to get to know the real me, because that cannot be captured on a one page resume. I intend to use this space as a blog of sorts where I share experiences, things I am learning, and topics that genuinely interest me. Each section leads to its own page with more detail, and I am continuing to build it out over time, so feel free to click around and explore.

I'm always open to feedback, ideas, and book recommendations as I keep improving this space. If something here connects with your career or company goals, I'd be glad to talk and see how we can help each other.
